title: Mage Flame: Retextured
description: A resourcepack of Improved textures of the Mage Flame mod's scrolls to look consistent with minecraft's vanilla textures.
body:
# ![arrow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f296ca2ec3e48bfcf91c4e9ff5b41a60a1a1f40f.png) About
This resourcepack slightly alters the textures of the scrolls in the [Mage Flame](https://modrinth.com/mod/mage-flame) mod, retextured it to be vanilla-like while staying true to the mod author's original textures.

# ![arrow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f296ca2ec3e48bfcf91c4e9ff5b41a60a1a1f40f.png) Preview

<details>
<summary>⛏️ Items</summary>

![Scrolls](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4eb4bb57363f3cc3fbb105aa4151334d70ee5c9b.png)

</details>

# ![arrow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f296ca2ec3e48bfcf91c4e9ff5b41a60a1a1f40f.png) Misc.

<details>
<summary>⚙️ Installation</summary>

1. Download and install the [Mage Flame](https://modrinth.com/mod/mage-flame) mod and it's dependencies.
1. Download the [resourcepack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mage-flame-retextured/versions).
1. Copy the .zip file.
1. In your `.minecraft` directory go to the `resourcepacks` folder.
1. Copy and paste the resourcepack into the `resourcepacks` folder.
1. Open Minecraft and activate the resourcepack.

</details>
